Masters of medicine and chemical arts, alchemists transform knowledge into healing power. Five constellations of discovery radiate from the alchemist's core - each unlocking deeper mastery of the body's secrets.

Successful medical tends build Eureka insight stacks that boost tend quality and work speed for crafting. Stacks decay slowly over time. Tier 1: max 5 stacks, +3% each. Tier 2: max 8 stacks, +4% each. Tier 3: max 12 stacks, +5% each. Tier 4: max 16 stacks, +6% each.
Those who command the wild hold dominion over beast and field alike. Five primal constellations mark the beastmaster's bond - each deepening the connection between handler and animal.

Each bonded animal on the same map grants passive bonuses to taming, training, and animal gather yield. Tier 1: +3% per animal (max 3). Tier 2: +4% per animal (max 5). Tier 3: +5% per animal (max 7). Tier 4: +6% per animal (max 10).
Unstoppable killing machines who grow stronger with every foe they fell. Five constellations of fury diverge from the berserker's core - each channeling primal rage into devastating power.

Every kill within a short time window stacks Blood Frenzy, boosting melee damage and move speed. Keep the carnage flowing or lose your stacks. Tier 1: max 3 stacks, +5% each. Tier 2: max 5 stacks, +6% each. Tier 3: max 7 stacks, +7% each. Tier 4: max 10 stacks, +8% each.

Masters of creation who bend raw materials to their will. Five constellations radiate from the crafter's core - each honing a different facet of their boundless ingenuity. The higher your natural Crafting skill, the more Masterwork Insight amplifies your work speed.

The Crafter's deep understanding of materials compounds with natural skill. Work speed scales with Crafting skill level - the higher their innate talent, the more the passive tree amplifies output. Masterwork Insight scales along the Mastercraft Path. Tier 1 (Apprentice's Eye): up to +15% at Crafting 20. Tier 2 (Journeyman's Hand): up to +30%. Tier 3 (Master's Touch): up to +50%. Tier 4 (Grand Master): up to +75%. Skill is the foundation - mastery is the reward.

Masters of the blade who turn defense into devastation. Five constellations radiate from the duelist's core - each honing a different edge of their relentless technique. Dodge incoming strikes to charge Counter Strike, then unleash every stored charge in a single devastating blow.

Every melee attack that misses the Duelist (dodge) stores a counter charge. The next outgoing melee hit consumes ALL charges for bonus melee damage. Counter Strike scales along the Centerpoint Path. Tier 1 (Parry): max 3 charges, +7% melee damage each (max +21%). Tier 2 (Riposte): max 5 charges, +8% each (max +40%). Tier 3 (Blade Dance): max 7 charges, +9% each (max +63%). Tier 4 (Perfect Counter): max 10 charges, +10% each (max +100%). Turn their mistakes into your victory.

Natural commanders who amplify the colony's potential through sheer force of personality. Five constellations radiate from the leader's core - each representing a different dimension of authority. The larger the colony they command, the more effective their Rallying Presence becomes.

The Leader's social effectiveness scales with colony size. More free colonists means stronger social impact, negotiation, and trade prices. Rallying Presence scales along the Rally Path. Tier 1 (Rallying Cry): +2% per colonist, max 8 counted (max +16%). Tier 2 (Battle Standard): +2.5% per colonist, max 12 counted (max +30%). Tier 3 (Champion's Aura): +3% per colonist, max 16 counted (max +48%). Tier 4 (Supreme Commander): +3.5% per colonist, max 20 counted (max +70%). The bigger the colony, the more powerful the Leader becomes.

Wielders of arcane power, mages channel intelligence and wisdom into unstoppable mental force. Five constellations diverge from the mage's core - each refining a distinct facet of their boundless intellect and psychic potential. Keep psyfocus high to unleash Arcane Overflow.

The higher a mage's psyfocus, the more arcane energy overflows from their mind - amplifying psychic sensitivity and mental acuity. Arcane Overflow scales along the Archmage's Path. Tier 1 (Acolyte): above 50% psyfocus -> up to +20% Psychic Sensitivity. Tier 2 (Adept): above 40% -> up to +35%. Tier 3 (Magister): above 30% -> up to +55%. Tier 4 (Archmage): above 20% -> up to +80%. Also boosts research speed at half strength. Scales linearly - maximum bonus at 100% focus.

Unyielding guardians of the colony, Paladins turn punishment into power. Five constellations diverge from the paladin's core - each forging a different facet of their iron will. Absorb damage through the Sanctuary's Vow to unleash Divine Retribution on your next strike.

Every blow the Paladin endures is stored as retribution charge. The next outgoing melee strike releases that charge as a burst of bonus damage, then resets. Divine Retribution scales along the Sanctuary's Vow. Tier 1 (Saint's Guard): up to +15% bonus damage at full charge (50 dmg). Tier 2 (Iron Covenant): up to +30% (75 dmg). Tier 3 (Vow of Steel): up to +45% (100 dmg). Tier 4 (Holy Wrath): up to +60% (150 dmg). Charge is capped per tier - take hits, then retaliate.

Veterans of the wild who blend marksmanship with survival instinct. Five constellations radiate from the ranger's core - each honing a different edge of their deadly craft. Lock onto prey and let Predator Focus sharpen every successive shot.

Consecutive ranged hits on the same target stack focus marks, each boosting Shooting Accuracy. Switching targets resets stacks to 1 on the new prey. Predator Focus scales along the Hawkeye Path. Tier 1 (Keen Eye): max 3 stacks, +4% accuracy each (max +12%). Tier 2 (Focused Aim): max 4 stacks, +5% each (max +20%). Tier 3 (Lethal Precision): max 5 stacks, +6% each (max +30%). Tier 4 (Apex Predator): max 7 stacks, +7% each (max +49%). Focus fire to devastate.

Masters of mind and medicine, Sages channel wisdom into healing, knowledge, and unshakeable mental clarity. Five constellations radiate from the sage's quiet core - each refining the art of supporting and understanding. Keep the battlefield at bay: silence restores the Sage's deepest gifts through Inner Calm.

The longer a Sage goes without taking damage, the more their clarity of mind amplifies their healing and research. Any hostile hit resets the calm timer entirely. Inner Calm scales along the Ascetic Path. Tier 1 (Tranquil Mind): calm builds over 4 in-game hours -> up to +20% TendQuality and SurgerySuccess, +10% Research. Tier 2 (Serene Focus): builds over 3 hours -> up to +35% / +18%. Tier 3 (Sage's Peace): builds over 2 hours -> up to +55% / +28%. Tier 4 (Perfect Stillness): builds over 1 hour -> up to +80% / +40%. Scales linearly - maximum bonus at full calm duration.

Unbreakable souls who thrive where others perish. Five constellations radiate from the survivor's core - each forging a different link in their chain of endurance. When conditions worsen and mood drops, Unyielding Spirit kicks in to keep the Survivor alive against all odds.

When the Survivor's mood drops below 50%, their body fights harder to stay alive. Immunity gain speed and rest effectiveness scale inversely with mood - the worse things get, the stronger the survival instinct. Unyielding Spirit scales along the Unyielding Path. Tier 1 (Never Yield): up to +20% at 0% mood. Tier 2 (Defiant Stand): up to +35%. Tier 3 (Last Stand): up to +55%. Tier 4 (Indomitable Will): up to +80%. The darkness fuels the will to survive.

Masters of melee combat, knights channel raw strength and iron discipline into devastating physical prowess. Five constellations diverge from the knight's core - each leading to a unique keystone that defines your fighting style.

The lower a knight's health, the fiercer they fight. Wrath unlocks progressively along the Warlord's Path. Tier 1 (Knight's Resolve): below 50% HP -> up to +25% melee damage. Tier 2 (Hardened Veteran): below 50% HP -> up to +35%. Tier 3 (Conqueror's Will): below 50% HP -> up to +50%. Tier 4 (Warlord's Domain): below 50% HP -> up to +75%.
